# Level 5: Many worlds {#sec-level-5}

::: {.callout-note title="Level 5 at a glance" appearance="simple"}
**Builds on:** Level 4 · **New components:** Parallel board, world markers · **Playing time:** about 90 minutes
:::

## What's new {#sec-level-5-new}

A piece's two possible positions can be on two parallel boards, and the game uses expert scoring.
